scripts.release: npm run release:dossier && npm run release:noperi
scripts.release:dossier: ./versions.sh sh -c 'docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --target production -t sanjeevstunner/dossier:$DOSSIER_VERSION -t sanjeevstunner/dossier:latest --push dossier'
scripts.release:noperi: ./versions.sh sh -c 'docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t sanjeevstunner/noperi:$NOPERI_VERSION -t sanjeevstunner/noperi:latest --push noperi-ts'
